data.raw_text:
🚨 SBI just dropped a bombshell partnership with Chainlink.

Everyone’s asking: does this threaten Ripple + $XRP?

Here’s the breakdown 👇🧵

First, context:
SBI Group = Japan’s financial giant 🇯🇵 with $200B+ in assets.
They’re Ripple’s #1 ally in Asia.

SBI Remit uses XRP in live corridors (Japan→Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand).

SBI VC Trade lists XRP.

CEO Kitao has called XRP the “global standard.”

Now comes the SBI x Chainlink deal.
Focus areas:

Tokenized funds & real-world assets (real estate, bonds)

Regulated stablecoins

FX settlement with Payment-vs-Payment (PvP)

Liquidity + compliance rails for institutions

This is big league infrastructure.

What Chainlink brings to SBI:

CCIP → Cross-chain interoperability & messaging

SmartData (NAV) → Fund pricing / data oracles

Proof of Reserve → Audits + compliance

Translation: Chainlink handles the instructions and data.

But here’s the key: Chainlink doesn’t provide liquidity.
It can route trades.
It can prove reserves.
It can sync data across chains.
But when it comes to actually settling value?
That’s not Chainlink’s role.

This is where Ripple + $XRP stay critical.

SBI Remit already settles payments in XRP.

XRP bridges currencies where tokenized cash isn’t available.

XRP is regulator-approved in Japan as a crypto asset.

Ripple = the liquidity muscle.

Think of it like this:

🧠 Chainlink = Control Layer (messaging, compliance, data)

💪 Ripple/XRP = Settlement Layer (bridging money across borders)

🏦 SBI = The Integrator combining both into one financial stack.

So does this threaten Ripple?
❌ No.
✅ It expands the rails.

SBI is hedging smartly — building a multi-rail system.
That way tokenized FX, stablecoins, and RWAs on Chainlink rails…
…can still settle in XRP when needed.

SBI isn’t choosing Chainlink over Ripple.
They’re choosing both.
Because the future of finance isn’t one-rail.
It’s interoperability + liquidity.

And that puts $XRP in the perfect spot to settle everything. 🌍🔥

⚡️ If you found this useful:
👉 Like + Retweet for visibility
👉 Follow @RipBullWinkle for daily crypto breakdowns

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 1:25 AM, 26 August 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon and Laguna.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Zambales and Pampanga within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Batangas, Cavite, Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan and Bataan which may persist within 1-2 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
